arguments.where_clause: transaction_type = 'Online Transaction' AND amount_usd_cents > 20000 AND card_id IN (SELECT c.id FROM cards c JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND u.credit_score < 650)
arguments.explanation: Flags online transactions over $200 made on credit cards whose owner has a credit score below 650.
assumptions: 'Over $200' means strictly more than $200, i.e. amount_usd_cents > 20000.
'Credit cards' means card_type = 'Credit' only, excluding 'Debit' and 'Debit (Prepaid)'.
The owner's credit score is taken from users.credit_score via cards.user_id; owners with a missing score are not flagged.
Negative amounts are not special-cased, so they cannot match the over-$200 condition.
